title: Change Impact Inspector: config/model-linked quality dashboard + alert channels
creator: Lena Ortiz
description: Build a Change Impact Inspector that ties eval quality deltas to explicit config and model changes, surfaces results in a dedicated Console dashboard, and sends deduplicated notifications to Slack and PagerDuty. The goal is to reduce noisy regression alerts during normal rollouts and give engineers a fast path from signal to remediation (rollback, patch PR, or ignore with rationale).
motivation: Customers and platform teams are seeing eval regressions triggered by routine config changes (quantization, batching, routing) and staged rollouts. Current alerts flood channels with contextless failures. We need an inspector that attributes deltas to change vectors, groups related alerts, and lets operators triage or mute per-rollout without losing auditability.
scope_includes: Eval delta attribution keyed by change vector: model_version, quant_profile, batch_config, routing_policy, compiler_flag
Dedicated dashboard view: change timeline, per-test-case delta histogram, cohort-level aggregated metrics, and linked rollout ID
Alert adapter enhancements: Slack summarized thread + interactive ack/mute buttons; PagerDuty dedupe using fingerprint = rollout_id|model_version|testset
Dedupe/suppression heuristics: time-window grouping (default 30m), adaptive suppression for high-noise tests, and manual overrides
Statistical significance gating: optional bootstrap-based confidence to reduce false positives for small sample deltas
Runbook links, rollback/PR shortcuts, and one-click mute tied to rollout lifecycle
Backfill and historical comparison for 30 days to surface latent regressions after backfill of new metrics
out_of_scope: Full rewrite of eval pipeline or test-case authoring UX
Automated code rollbacks (we provide links/PR templates only)
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard surfaces change events and corresponding eval score deltas in a unified timeline
Slack alerts are grouped into a single thread per change vector and include summary metrics, top 10 impacted test cases, and links to console details
PagerDuty incidents are deduplicated by fingerprint and only fired when aggregated severity exceeds configured threshold
Users can mute alerts for a given rollout ID from the alert or dashboard; muting is recorded in audit logs
Adaptive suppression prevents >50% of repeated noisy signals from the same testset during a 24h window while allowing new-signature regressions to surface
Integration tests exist for fingerprint dedupe, Slack thread creation, and mute/unmute flows
SLO: fewer than 5 manual triage hours per week added for on-call during first month of rollout for customers with normal traffic
technical_notes: Fingerprint design: SHA256(rollout_id + '|' + model_version + '|' + quant_profile + '|' + testset_id) truncated to 64 bits for PD key
Significance test: bootstrap on paired differences with configurable alpha (default 0.01) to gate PD alerts
Payload size: Slack thread summary limited to 6 key metrics + top 10 testcases; deep link to Console for full details
Storage: store snapshot of eval inputs, outputs, and config diffs for 90 days for auditability
Telemetry: emit event types eval.change.detected, eval.change.grouped, eval.alert.fired, eval.alert.suppressed with rollout_id and fingerprint tags
Backfill: run nightly re-eval on snapshot window for 30 days when new metric is onboarded; surface synthetic baseline in UI
ui_wireframe_notes: Left column: chronological Change Inspector feed grouped by rollout; middle: per-change summary card (delta, CI, impact score); right: detailed test case table with sparkline and sample inputs/outputs
Top-bar controls: time window selector, model/config filters, 'only unresolved' toggle
In-thread Slack actions: Acknowledge (adds PD note), Mute rollout (duration options), Open Console
PagerDuty mapping: if multiple fingerprints share rollout_id, they should be grouped into a single incident with a sub-list of fingerprints
privacy_and_security_considerations: Eval payloads may contain user-provided prompts. Ensure PII redaction at ingestion and only include safe identifiers in Slack/PagerDuty messages
Audit log entries must include user who muted/unmuted and the rationale string
KMS-encrypted snapshots for private deployments; on-host snapshots for Private customers remain in customer VPC storage
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): API and backend fingerprinting + internal Console view + test Slack channel integration (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (beta): PD dedupe logic + mute/unmute + customer opt-in (3 weeks)
Phase 3 (GA): adaptive suppression tuning, backfill support, public docs and runbook (2 weeks)
Post-GA: telemetry dashboards, customer feedback cycle, and SLO adjustments (ongoing)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-suppression may hide real regressions. Mitigation: conservative default thresholds and an 'open' mode where suppression only annotates but does not silence PD
Risk: Slack channel noise from non-actionable change metadata. Mitigation: compact summaries and mandatory deep-link to Console instead of dumping raw diffs
Risk: False fingerprint collisions. Mitigation: include rollout_id + hashed config vector and monitor collision rate; bump hash size if collisions exceed 1 in 10M
metrics_to_track: Median time to acknowledge and mute
Number of PD incidents deduplicated / month
False suppression rate (manual unmute within suppression window)
